briefing.summary: Non-radar segment. Just passed compulsory reporting waypoint MARLE at time 0345Z, cruising FL220.

challenge.prompt: Make the compulsory waypoint report — abbreviated form (no ETA for next waypoint required).
challenge.expectedText: Mike X-ray Golf, MARLE at four five, flight level two two zero.
challenge.explanation: AIP ENR 1.5: abbreviated position report when ATC has waived the next-waypoint ETA — callsign, position, time, level. Use the full form (with next waypoint + ETA) on initial check-in or when first entering a non-radar area.
